_readme: UHN CNS ependymoma case, v1. COPY THIS FILE TO HOSPITAL STORAGE on the UHN PC (outside matRadDWA and outside any AI-connected folder), fill reb.protocol, the paths and the beams, and pass its path to UHN_CNS_01/02/03. alias = study code only. UHN_CNS_01 imports source.dicomDir (CT, RS1, RP1, RD1; MR and REG are ignored) once and saves source.path.

prescription._check: UHN_CNS_01 prints the RTPLAN fraction number: correct numOfFractions if it differs

beams._readme: Start with beamCandidates set A (2 + 4 o'clock). Change after the beam screen in UHN_CNS_02.
